proposals.evidence: Full bhasman gives Kashmiri bas fine dust, Lahnda/Punjabi bhas/bhass ashes and West Pahari bhass dust. These support Kullu baːs/bʰaːs ash, preserving source vowel quantity and aspiration with cross-IA transmission qualified. Do not choose the separate bhāsma branch 2 solely from long vowel spelling. Exact response: baːs.
